item.title: Valentine’s Day revenues expected to hit £1.6bn
item.description: Retailers are expected to experience a major sales boost on Valentine’s Day (14 February), with spending predicted to rise by 12% to £1.6bn according to research from shopper marketing agency Savvy.

item.title: Aldi to invest over £300m in UK store upgrades
item.description: Aldi is set to invest over £300m in upgrading and extending its existing UK stores in 2026, as part of its continued commitment to investing in Britain.

item.title: Dreams launches North East store and distribution centre
item.description: Dreams is expanding its footprint in the North East to meet growing consumer demand, with the launch of a new distribution centre and store in Sunderland.

item.title: Amazon expands Iceland grocery partnership
item.description: Amazon has expanded its Iceland grocery partnership nationwide, to include cities such as Belfast, Cardiff, Edinburgh and Nottingham.

item.title: Jigsaw to grow bricks-and-mortar footprint after festive sales hike
item.description: Luxury womenswear retailer Jigsaw is set to grow its store portfolio, after reporting a robust festive trading period and completing a strategic turnaround.

item.title: Co-op denies allegations of ‘toxic culture’ at the top
item.description: Co-op has defended its culture following reports that claimed senior managers had complained of a “toxic” environment at the business.
